rows.subtype: Approach: allowing feelings and staying with family [Thinking]
rows.description: After the sudden death of a grandfather, a teen lets herself cry, sits with the family through the rituals, and understands that grief is not something to hurry or hide.

rows.subtype: Approach: taking on practical tasks for the family [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: talking with trusted people about the loss [Action]
rows.description: A student tells a close friend and a teacher what has happened and shares memories of her father, so she is not carrying the grief in silence.

rows.subtype: Approach: adjusting study and exam plans with school support [Action]

rows.subtype: Approach: suppressing emotion to seem strong [Pitfall]
rows.description: A boy told to be the man of the house hides his tears, throws himself into chores and studying, and weeks later finds outbursts and sleeplessness because the grief was never expressed.

rows.subtype: Approach: avoiding reminders and refusing to talk [Pitfall]
rows.description: A teen puts away every photo and leaves the room when the person is mentioned, hoping the pain will vanish, but avoidance keeps it sharp and distances him from family who want to share.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: buffer and slack, forward planning

rows.description: A teen writes a letter to her grandmother, lights a lamp on her birthday, and cooks her favourite dish with the family, finding a lasting way to keep the bond.

rows.subtype: Approach: noticing when grief becomes overwhelming and seeking support [Revision]
rows.description: Months later, a student still cannot concentrate or sleep, so he tells his mother, who arranges a talk with a school counsellor, an appropriate step and not a weakness.

rows.subtype: Approach: supporting a grieving family member [Action]
rows.description: A teen sits quietly with his widowed mother in the evenings, offers tea, listens when she wants to talk, and avoids empty phrases, accepting that presence matters more than solving her pain.

rows.subtype: Approach: adapting routines to a changed household [Revision]
